Tip for `mem_ballWithin_one_of_adj`:
`p.length` is 1 by `rfl`:
```lean
lemma mem_ballWithin_one_of_adj {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (c u : V) (hadj : G.Adj c u) :
    u ∈ ballWithin G 1 c := by
  have p : G.Walk c u := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hadj SimpleGraph.Walk.nil
  have hp : p.length = 1 := rfl
  rw [← hp]
  exact mem_ballWithin_of_walk G p
```
